llm_fields.description: The Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme provides financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry to enable them to start or expand business activities related to leatherwork.
llm_fields.eligibility: A Self-Help Group must have at least 10 female artisans; the applicant must belong to specified sub‑castes among scheduled castes; the applicant must be at least 18 years old; annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas and ₹25,000 in urban areas; the applicant or family must not have received benefits from other schemes except training programs; family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
